summary: Select signed release packaging only for complete platform credential sets, notarize macOS with an App Store Connect API key, fail closed for partial secrets, and retain an explicit unsigned contributor path.

reactNativeIos.reason: The React Native/iOS release channel and package identity are unchanged; this feature governs Electron release artifacts only.

nativeAndroid.reason: Android uses its separate production keystore workflow documented in docs/releasing.md and is not packaged by electron-builder.

sharedBackendApi.reason: Signing selection changes artifact production and does not alter the Desktop/mobile wire contract.

storageDataMigration.reason: Signing adds no stored data or migration. The keychain item that safeStorage uses may ask once for access after an ad-hoc install updates to a Developer ID build; docs/releasing.md records it.

automated: tests/unit/signing-mode.test.ts covers absent, complete and partial credentials (the old Apple ID set is now partial), the production builder overlay, the API key written to a file, the afterSign notarize, staple retry and checks and the macOS Bash 3.2 unsigned packaging path
Signed release jobs run codesign --verify --deep --strict with the identifier-only update requirement, spctl --assess --type exec and stapler validate, or Authenticode verification
notExercised: An auto-update from the installed ad-hoc build to a Developer ID build is not exercised end to end, because that needs a published release. afterSign checks the requirement ShipIt uses on every signed build, and the dry-run artifact can be checked by hand with codesign.
Production Windows Authenticode was not exercised because no Windows certificate is configured.
